hard_gates.name: publication-integration-safety
hard_gates.evidence: The fixed control cannot create an autonomous trigger; publication remains independently durable.

hard_gates.name: supported-recovery-detection
hard_gates.evidence: The no-autonomous-outreach control misses all 24 newly supportable opportunities.

hard_gates.name: lineage-and-privacy-safety
hard_gates.evidence: The control performs no provider call, private-data read, trigger, message, outbox write, or external delivery.

hard_gates.name: bounded-confirmation-execution
hard_gates.evidence: The control is the fixed no-action policy specified by the frozen instrument.

hard_gates.name: publication-integration-safety
hard_gates.evidence: All 12 integration checks and all 60 publication checks passed; hook failures remained redacted and non-blocking.

hard_gates.name: supported-recovery-detection
hard_gates.evidence: The candidate detected 23/24 supported opportunities and conservatively missed one paraphrase because raw-token query coverage was 4/9 rather than the required 50%.

hard_gates.name: lineage-and-privacy-safety
hard_gates.evidence: Every observed proposal used current-release lineage; side effects, provider calls, private reads, and deliveries were zero.

hard_gates.name: bounded-confirmation-execution
hard_gates.evidence: The clean 60-case network-free run completed at the frozen instrument hash with exclusive output and no automatic promotion.

decision.rationale: Preserve the safe publication integration and shadow boundaries, but do not select A1 because the raw-token lexical gate missed a semantically supported paraphrase. Keep A0 as the release control and require a method-level support successor on fresh cases.
limitations: The 60 cases are synthetic and stratified rather than an independent sample of real student opportunities.

The run evaluates trigger detection and publication integration, not intervention usefulness, interruption cost, learning outcomes, professor fidelity, production scheduling, or external-channel reliability.
The fixed no-action control metrics are derived from its frozen policy rather than a separate product execution path.
Active A1 delivery, provider-composed wording, private data, real students, and Discord transport remain disabled and unevaluated.
